privacyNotice.title: Privacy Notice
privacyNotice.subtitle: For Users of Small Business Finance
privacyNotice.intro: This notice supplements our Privacy Policy and explains how we collect, use, disclose and retain personal information, and how you can submit a privacy request.

responsibleParty.title: 1. Who We Are
responsibleParty.content:
Omer Faruk Ozadali
Istanbul, Türkiye
Email: ozadaliomerfaruk@gmail.com

information.title: 2. Information We Collect
information.content:
The information processed falls into four main groups:

User information: Account details such as email, name, business name and optional phone number.

Business and account information: Business ledger, account and transaction records created in the service, together with documents and images you add.

Contact information: Only the name and phone number you choose from your address book and transfer to the form.

Technical information: Connection, session, security, notification and limited usage records between your device and the service.

collectionAndUse.title: 3. How We Collect and Use Information
collectionAndUse.content:
We collect information electronically from details you enter, your chosen sign-in provider, device features you choose to use, and session or technical activity generated while providing the service.

We use it to create and manage your account, operate and sync the app, produce reports and reminders, support authorized team access, maintain security, provide support and comply with law. We will provide additional notice or request consent before using personal information in another way when applicable law requires it.

sharing.title: 4. When We Disclose Information
sharing.content:
To operate the service, we may disclose information to cloud hosting, sign-in, file storage, notification, AI-based document processing and technical support providers; users authorized by the business owner; parties involved in a sharing action you initiate; people who have a time-limited statement link you create; and government or law-enforcement authorities when required by law.

We do not sell personal information or use it for targeted advertising based on activity across other companies’ apps or websites. We and our service providers may process information in countries other than where you live, as permitted by applicable law.

retentionAndSecurity.title: 5. Retention and Security
retentionAndSecurity.content:
We retain information while your account is active and for as long as needed to provide the service, meet legal obligations, resolve disputes and protect the service. We use reasonable administrative, technical and organizational safeguards designed to prevent unauthorized access.

A 7-day waiting period applies to account deletion requests. You may cancel during this period. Afterward, the account is closed and the deletion request is processed. Limited records required by law, and business records that must remain in another business workspace, may be retained only for the necessary period and purpose.

rightsAndRequests.title: 6. Your Privacy Choices and Requests
rightsAndRequests.content:
Depending on where you live, applicable U.S. state or other privacy laws may let you request access to personal information, information about its sources, uses and recipients, correction, deletion or a portable copy. Where provided by law, you may also object to certain processing or appeal a denied request. We do not discriminate against users for exercising applicable privacy rights.

To submit a request, email ozadaliomerfaruk@gmail.com from the address registered to your account and use the subject “Privacy Request.” We may ask for information needed to verify your identity and will respond within the period required by applicable law. If you do not have an account, contact us at the same address for instructions.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: By using the Small Business Finance application, you agree to the following terms.

serviceDescription.title: 1. Service Description
serviceDescription.content:
Small Business Finance is a financial tracking and management application developed for small and medium-sized businesses. The application offers income-expense tracking, client account management, staff records and payment tracking, product and inventory management, notes and task management, and financial reporting tools.

The application does not provide official accounting, payroll, tax, or legal advisory services.

usageTerms.title: 2. Usage Terms and Age Restriction
usageTerms.content:
You must be at least 13 years old to use this application. Use of the application by individuals under 13 is prohibited.

Users are responsible for the accuracy, currency, and legal compliance of all data entered into the application. Small Business Finance cannot be held responsible for consequences arising from incorrect or incomplete data entry.

accountSecurity.title: 3. Account Security
accountSecurity.content: Users are obligated to keep account information confidential and prevent unauthorized access. Users are responsible for all transactions performed through their account.

multiUser.title: 4. Multi-User Access
multiUser.content:
Business owners can invite other users to their business by generating invite codes. Invited users are assigned one of the following roles: manager, operator, or custom. Each role has different access permissions.

Business owners can restrict or revoke invited users' access at any time. Business owners are responsible for the actions of invited users on business data.

In addition, a business owner may share a specific client account with another business via a share code. Depending on the granted permission, the other business can only view or edit the information belonging to that client account, and cannot access the business's other data. Client sharing can be revoked at any time.

dataSecurity.title: 5. Data Security
dataSecurity.content: User data is stored on secure servers with reasonable technical security measures. However, it is acknowledged that data transmission over the internet is not completely risk-free.

accountDeletion.title: 6. Account Deletion
accountDeletion.content: Users can submit a deletion request through Settings > Delete My Account. The request may be cancelled during the 7-day waiting period. Afterward, the account is closed and the deletion request is processed. Limited records required by law, and business records that must remain in another business workspace, may be retained only for the necessary period and scope.

dataExport.title: 7. Data Export
dataExport.content: Users can export transaction data and reports in Excel (.xlsx) and PDF formats from within the application. Files are prepared for the device's sharing interface, where the user may share or save them. Users are responsible for any sharing of exported data with third parties.

thirdParty.title: 8. Third-Party Services
thirdParty.content: The application may use third-party services such as Apple ID and Google Account for authentication. Use of these services is subject to the respective service providers' own terms of use.

serviceChanges.title: 9. Service Changes
serviceChanges.content: Small Business Finance reserves the right to change the application's service content, features, and pricing without prior notice.

intellectualProperty.title: 10. Intellectual Property
intellectualProperty.content: The design, software and brand elements of the Small Business Finance application belong to Small Business Finance. Business records entered into the app belong to the relevant business workspace, and the business owner manages team access. Ending a team member's access does not automatically delete records they created for the business.

liability.title: 11. Limitation of Liability
liability.content: Small Business Finance cannot be held liable for indirect damages arising from use of the application. The application is provided "as is."

disputes.title: 12. Dispute Resolution
disputes.content: Any disputes arising from these terms shall be governed by the laws of the Republic of Turkey, and Istanbul Courts shall have jurisdiction.

contact.title: 13. Contact
contact.content:
For questions about terms of use:
ozadaliomerfaruk@gmail.com

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: We care about the privacy of the information you share when using Small Business Finance. This policy briefly explains what data we use and why.

data.title: 1. What Information Do We Use?
data.content:
The following groups of information may be processed when you use the service:

User information: Account details such as email, name, business name and optional phone number.

Business and account information: Business ledger, account and transaction records created in the service, together with documents and images you add.

Contact information: Only the name and phone number you choose from your address book and transfer to the form.

Technical information: Connection, session, security, notification and limited usage records between your device and the service.

usage.title: 2. Why Do We Use Data?
usage.content:
We use data to operate the app, synchronize records across devices, create reports and reminders, enable work with authorized team members, maintain security and provide support.

Your records are stored in secure cloud infrastructure solely to serve your account. Limited technical usage records may be used to improve the service. We do not sell personal data or use it for cross-app advertising tracking.

permissions.title: 3. Device Permissions
permissions.content:
Contacts, camera/photo, file and notification permissions are requested only when you choose the related feature. The app does not retrieve or upload the entire address book; only the selected person's name and phone number are copied into the form, and this information is not sent to the server until the user taps “Save.”

If you choose document/invoice scanning, the image is sent to an AI-based document processing service to extract its fields automatically. You can change permissions in device settings.

sharing.title: 4. Sharing and Service Providers
sharing.content:
Data may be shared with team members within permissions granted by the business owner, with a party involved in a client-account sharing action you initiate, or with people who have a time-limited statement link you create. A statement link works until it expires or you revoke it.

We use authentication, secure cloud hosting, file storage, notification and document processing services to provide the app. If you enable notifications, a device token, platform/language details and limited content needed to deliver the notification are processed through the notification infrastructure. These providers process data only as needed for the service. We and our service providers may process information in countries other than where you live. Information may also be disclosed to government or law-enforcement authorities when required by law.

retention.title: 5. Retention, Export and Deletion
retention.content:
Data is retained while your account is active and as needed for the service. You may export selected lists, statements and reports from the app.

A 7-day waiting period applies to account deletion requests, and you may cancel during this period. Afterward, the account is closed and the deletion request is processed. Limited records required by law, and business records that must remain in another business workspace, may be retained only for the necessary period and scope.

rights.title: 6. Your Rights and Contact
rights.content:
To access your data, correct inaccurate data, request deletion where applicable, object to processing or ask a question, contact us at:

ozadaliomerfaruk@gmail.com

Material policy changes will be announced in the app or on the website.
